entries.title: Psalms 71:1
segments: ¶In thee, Jehovah, do I trust: let me never be ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 71:2
segments: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me; incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

entries.title: Psalms 71:3
segments: Be to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

entries.title: Psalms 71:4
segments: My God, rescue me out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

entries.title: Psalms 71:5
segments: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah, my confidence from my youth.

entries.title: Psalms 71:6
segments: On thee have I been stayed from the womb; from the bowels of my mother thou didst draw me forth: my praise shall be continually of thee.

entries.title: Psalms 71:7
segments: I have been as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 71:8
segments: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, with thy glory, all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 71:9
segments: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

entries.title: Psalms 71:10
segments: For mine enemies speak against me, and they that watch for my soul consult together,

entries.title: Psalms 71:11
segments: Saying, God hath forsaken him; pursue and seize him, for there is none to deliver.

entries.title: Psalms 71:12
segments: O God, be not far from me; my God, hasten to my help.

entries.title: Psalms 71:13
segments: Let them be ashamed, let them be consumed, that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 71:14
segments: ¶But as for me, I will hope continually, and will praise thee yet more and more.

entries.title: Psalms 71:15
segments: My mouth shall declare thy righteousness, [and] thy salvation all the day: for I know not the numbers [thereof].

entries.title: Psalms 71:16
segments: I will go in the might of the Lord Jehovah; I will recall thy righteousness, thine alone.

entries.title: Psalms 71:17
segments: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth, and hitherto have I proclaimed thy marvellous works:

entries.title: Psalms 71:18
segments: Now also, when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not, until I have proclaimed thine arm unto [this] generation, thy might to every one that is to come.

entries.title: Psalms 71:19
segments: And thy righteousness, O God, reacheth on high, thou who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee?

entries.title: Psalms 71:20
segments: Thou, who hast shewn us many and sore troubles, wilt revive us again, and wilt bring us up again from the depths of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 71:21
segments: Thou wilt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

entries.title: Psalms 71:22
segments: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, my God; unto thee will I sing psalms with the harp, thou holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 71:23
segments: My lips shall exult when I sing psalms unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

entries.title: Psalms 71:24
segments: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day; for they shall be ashamed, for they shall be brought to confusion, that seek my hurt.
